Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
My God
Do not let my enemy rejoice at my misfortune

Arabic text: وَلَا تَفْجَعْ بِيْ حَمِيْمِيْ وَ صَدِيْقِيْ
Translation: And do not afflict my intimate friends and companions with grief over me

Arabic text: اِلٰهِيْ هَبْ لِيْ لَحْظَةً مِنْ لَحَظَاتِكَ
Translation: My God, grant me a glance from Your glances
That removes from me the affliction You have tested me with
And return me to the best of Your customary favors toward me

Arabic text: وَاسْتَجِبْ دُعَائِيْ وَدُعَاءَ مَنْ أَخْلَصَ لَكَ دُعَاءَهُ فَقَدْ
Translation: And answer my prayer and the prayer of those who have sincerely called upon You, for
My strength has weakened
My resources have diminished
My condition has worsened
And I have despaired of what Your creation possesses

Arabic text: فَلَمْ يَبْقَ لِيْ اِلَّا رَجَاؤُكَ عَلَيَّ
Translation: Nothing remains for me except hope in Your favor upon me
My God

Arabic text: اِنَّ قُدْرَتَكَ عَلٰى كَشْفِ مَا اَنَا فِيْهِ كَقُدْرَتِكَ عَلٰى مَا ابْتَلَيْتَنِيْ بِهِ
Translation: Your power to remove what I am in is like Your power over that with which You have afflicted me
And the remembrance of Your customary favors comforts me
And hope in Your blessings and grace strengthens me

Arabic text: لِأَنِّيْ لَمْ أَخْلُ مِنْ نِعْمَتِكَ مُنْذُ خَلَقْتَنِيْ
Translation: For I have never been devoid of Your blessings since You created me
And You, my God
Are my refuge and my shelter
And my protector and defender
The One who is compassionate toward me, merciful to me
The One who guarantees my sustenance

Arabic text: فِيْ قَضَآئِكَ كَانَ مَا حَلَّ بِيْ
Translation: In Your decree was what befell me
And by Your knowledge was what I have come to

Arabic text: فَاجْعَلْ يَا وَلِيِّيْ وَ سَيِّدِيْ فِيْمَا قَدَّرْتَ وَ قَضَيْتَ عَلَيَّ وَحَتَمْتَ
Translation: So make, O my Guardian and Master, in what You have decreed and ordained for me

Arabic text: عَافِيَتِيْ وَ مَا فِيْهِ صَلَاحِيْ وَ خَلَاصِيْ مِمَّا اَنَا فِيْهِ
Translation: My well-being and what contains my welfare and deliverance from what I am in

Arabic text: فَإِنِّيْ لَا اَرْجُوْ لِدَفْعِ ذٰلِكَ غَيْرَكَ
Translation: For I hope in none other than You to repel that
And I rely upon none but You in this

Arabic text: فَكُنْ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ عِنْدَ اَحْسَنِ ظَنِّيْ بِكَ
Translation: So be, O Possessor of Majesty and Honor, in accordance with my best expectations of You
And have mercy on my weakness and lack of resources
And remove my distress
And answer my prayer
And overlook my errors

Arabic text: وَ امْنُنْ عَلَيَّ بِذٰلِكَ وَ عَلٰى كُلِّ دَاعٍ لَكَ
Translation: And bestow that favor upon me and upon all who call upon You

Arabic text: اَمَرْتَنِيْ يَا سَيِّدِيْ بِالدُّعَآءِ وَ تَكَفَّلْتَ بِالْاِجَابَةِ
Translation: You have commanded me, O my Master, to supplicate, and You have guaranteed the response

Arabic text: وَوَعْدُكَ الْحَقُّ الَّذِيْ لَا خُلْفَ فِيْهِ وَلَا تَبْدِيْلَ
Translation: And Your promise is true, in which there is no breach nor alteration

Arabic text: فَصَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيِّكَ وَ عَبْدِكَ
Translation: So send blessings upon Muhammad, Your Prophet and servant
And upon the pure ones from his household
And help me, for You are
The helper of those who have no helper
And the protection of those who have no protection
And I am the distressed one for whom You have made obligatory

Arabic text: اِجَابَتَهُ وَكَشْفَ مَا بِهِ مِنَ السُّوْ ءِ
Translation: The answering of his prayer and the removal of his affliction
So answer me and remove my anxiety
And relieve my grief

Arabic text: وَ اَعِدْ حَالِيْ اِلٰى اَحْسَنِ مَا كَانَتْ عَلَيْهِ
Translation: And restore my condition to the best it was before

Arabic text: وَ لَا تُجَازِنِيْ بِالْاِسْتِحْقَاقِ وَ لٰكِنْ بِرَحْمَتِكَ الَّتِيْ وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْء
Translation: And do not deal with me according to what I deserve, but by Your mercy which encompasses all things
O Possessor of Majesty and Honor

Arabic text: صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: Send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: وَ اسْمَعْ وَ اَجِبْ يَا عَزِيْزُ
Translation: And hear and answer, O Mighty One
